ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entries حجب, غطا, كن, غشى (2026-11-06): 24 attributed points confirmed; changed — notes/0 (reworded): His wording وجعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه matches 6:25 and 17:46; 18:57 reads إنا جعلنا … أكنة; members/0/nuance (reworded): 'as befits Him' is not in his text (he adds 'and the one to whom it is conveyed', مبلغه); members/0/ayat/1/why (reworded): Same addition as in the nuance

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, ḥiǧāb je ono što sprečava da se do nečega dođe. O 7:46 kaže: to nije ono što zaklanja pogled, nego ono što sprečava da užitak stanovnika Dženneta dopre do stanovnika Vatre i da njihova muka dopre do stanovnika Dženneta. A ‚iza zastora‘ (42:51) znači: tako da Ga onaj kome se obraća ne vidi.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, ḥiǧāb is what keeps one from reaching a thing. On 7:46 he says it is not what blocks the sight, but what keeps the delight of the people of the Garden from reaching the people of the Fire, and their torment from reaching the people of the Garden. And ‘from behind a veil’ (42:51) means: so that the one spoken to does not see Him.

why.bs: „Između njih je zastor …“ – ar-Rāġib: pregrada koja sprečava da stanje jednih dopre do drugih.
why.en: “Between them is a veil.” — ar-Rāġib: a barrier that keeps the state of each from reaching the other.

why.bs: „Nijednom čovjeku nije dato da mu Allah govori osim objavom, ili iza zastora …“ – ar-Rāġib: tako da Ga onaj kome se obraća ne vidi.
why.en: “it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil” — ar-Rāġib: so that the one spoken to does not see Him.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, ġiṭāʾ je ono što se stavi preko nečega, poklopac i slično – kao što je ġišāʾ ono što se stavi preko nečega kao odjeća; prenosi se i na neznanje, i navodi 50:22. U Kur'anu (2 mjesta) oba puta o očima i pogledu.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, ġiṭāʾ is what is put over a thing, a lid and the like — as ġišāʾ is what is put over a thing like clothing; it is also carried over to ignorance, and he cites 50:22. In the Quran (2 places) both times of the eyes and the sight.

why.bs: „Bio si u nemaru prema ovome, a sada smo s tebe odmakli tvoj pokrivač, pa ti je pogled danas prodoran.“ – pokrivač neznanja je skinut; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
why.en: “Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering [ġiṭāʾ], and piercing is thy sight this day.” — the cover of ignorance is lifted; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

why.bs: „one čije su oči bile pod pokrivačem od sjećanja na Mene …“ – pokrivač preko očiju.
why.en: “Those whose eyes were hoodwinked [in a cover, ġiṭāʾ] from My reminder” — a cover over the eyes.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, kinn je ono u čemu se nešto čuva, a kinān je pokrivač u kojem je nešto zatvoreno, u množini akinna. U Kur'anu (svih 4 mjesta) akinna su uvijek na srcima ili su srca u njima.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, kinn is that in which a thing is kept, and kinān is the cover in which a thing is enclosed, plural akinna. In the Quran (all 4 places) the akinna are always upon hearts, or the hearts are in them.

why.bs: „I govore: ‚Naša srca su u omotačima od onoga čemu nas pozivaš, u ušima nam je gluhoća, a između nas i tebe je zastor …‘“ – riječi poricatelja: omotači na srcima i zastor između njih u jednom ajetu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
why.en: “Our hearts are protected [in sheaths, akinna] from that unto which thou (O Muhammad) callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil.” — the deniers' words: sheaths on the hearts and a veil between them in one ayah; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

why.bs: „… a Mi smo na njihova srca stavili omotače da ga ne bi razumjeli …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
why.en: “We have placed upon their hearts veils [akinna], lest they should understand” — ar-Rāġib cites these words.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, ġišāwa je ono čime se nešto prekrije. U Kur'anu (oba mjesta) je na očima i pogledu, uz pečat na sluhu i srcu (2:7, 45:23).
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, ġišāwa is that with which a thing is covered. In the Quran (both places) it is on the eyes and the sight, beside the seal on hearing and heart (2:7, 45:23).

why.bs: „Allah je stavio pečat na njihova srca i na njihov sluh, a preko njihovih očiju je koprena …“ – o onima opisanim u 2:6; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
why.en: “Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering [ġišāwa].” — of those described in 2:6; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

title.bs: Vrijeme: neko vrijeme, vijek i razdoblje
title.en: Time: a while, an age and a span

shared.bs: Sve tri riječi znače odsječak vremena. Razlikuju se po dužini i po tome šta ističu: neodređeno vrijeme koje se određuje onim uz šta stoji, dugo doba – izvorno vijek svijeta, ili razdoblje gledano prema svom kraju.
shared.en: All three words mean a stretch of time. They differ in length and in what they stress: an indefinite time fixed by what it stands with, a long age — at root the age of the world — or a span seen with regard to its end.

tellApart.bs: Neko vrijeme, neodređeno – ‚do nekog vremena‘, ‚u vrijeme kad‘ → حِين; dugo doba, vijek – izvorno trajanje svijeta → دَهْر; razdoblje s granicom, gledano prema kraju → أَمَد.
tellApart.en: A while, indefinite — ‘for a while’, ‘at the time when’ → حِين; a long age — at root the duration of the world → دَهْر; a span with a limit, seen with regard to its end → أَمَد.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries حين, دهر, أمد
notes: ar-Rāġib (حين): ḥīn is the time of a thing's coming about; its meaning is vague and is made specific by what it is annexed to (38:3); it comes in several senses: a term (10:98 wording 'wa-mattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīn'; 37:148 has fa-mattaʿnāhum), a year (14:25), an hour (30:17), time at large (76:1, 38:88) — 'it was explained according to what it was found tied to'; also used of the time of death. (دهر): dahr is at root the name of the world's duration from the beginning of its existence to its end (76:1); then any long span; unlike zamān, which falls on short and long; 'dahr of so-and-so' is his lifetime; on the hadith 'do not curse ad-dahr' he prefers 'Allah is the doer of what is ascribed to time'; on 45:24 'it was said: time (zamān) is meant'. (أمد): cites 3:30; amad and abad are close, but abad is a span of time with no bound and is not restricted ('abad of such' is not said), while amad is a span whose bound is unknown when said alone, and can be bounded ('the amad of such'), as one says 'the time of such'; amad is said with regard to the end (ġāya), zamān covers both start and end.

Quranic usage (our observation, all 33 / 2 / 4 ayat read): حِين — 'for a while' / 'until a while' (ilā ḥīn, ḥattā ḥīn: 2:36, 7:24, 12:35, 21:111, 23:25, 23:54, 36:44, 37:148, 37:174, 37:178, 51:43), 'when …' (ḥīna: 5:106, 16:6, 26:218, 30:17, 30:18, 39:42 …), 'every season' (14:25), 'after a while' (38:88); the count includes ḥīnaʾiḏin (56:84). دَهْر — 76:1 and the deniers' words in 45:24. أَمَد — 3:30, 18:12, 57:16, 72:25. Not cited: 14:25 (he says a year; mufassirun differ: a year, six months, morning and evening), 2:36 / 7:24 (Adam's descent, left out as in batch 8), 72:25 (said by the Prophet).
Blind review (2026-11-06, fresh Sonnet reviewer, claims checked against the cited ayat and the Mufradāt): 1 flag, fixed: 57:16 bs re-translated from the Arabic.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entries حين, دهر, أمد (2026-11-06): 21 attributed points confirmed; changed — notes/0 (reworded): ومتعناهم إلى حين with wa- is exactly 10:98; 37:148 reads فمتعناهم. On the hadith he gives both views and says والأول أظهر, so 'prefers' is right; members/0/ayat/0/why (reworded): Card is 37:148 (fa-mattaʿnāhum); his wa-mattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīn is 10:98. Alternative: swap the card to 10:98; members/1/ayat/0/why (reworded): He files ḥīn in 76:1 under 'time at large', not a short time; bs 'kratko' says more than en 'a while' and than he does

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, ḥīn je vrijeme kad se nešto zbude; značenje mu je neodređeno i određuje se onim čemu je pridodato. Javlja se kao rok, godina, sat ili vrijeme uopće – a, kaže on, tumačeno je prema onome uz šta je stajalo. U Kur'anu najčešće ‚do nekog vremena‘ i ‚u vrijeme kad …‘.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, ḥīn is the time when a thing comes about; its meaning is vague and is fixed by what it is joined to. It comes as a term, a year, an hour or time at large — and, he says, it was explained by what it stood with. In the Quran mostly ‘for a while’ and ‘at the time when …’.

why.bs: „I povjerovali su, pa smo im dali da uživaju do nekog vremena.“ – ḥīn kao rok; ar-Rāġib navodi iste riječi iz 10:98.
why.en: “And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.” — ḥīn as a term; ar-Rāġib cites the same words from 10:98.

why.bs: „Pa slavljen neka je Allah kad zanoćite i kad osvanete“ – ḥīn kao doba dana; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
why.en: “So glory be to Allah when ye enter the night and when ye enter the morning” — ḥīn as an hour of the day; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, dahr je izvorno ime za trajanje svijeta od početka do kraja, a zatim za svako dugo razdoblje – za razliku od zamān, koje se kaže i za kratko i za dugo. U Kur'anu samo dva puta (76:1, 45:24).
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, dahr is at root the name for the duration of the world from its beginning to its end, and then for any long span — unlike zamān, which is said of short and long alike. In the Quran only twice (76:1, 45:24).

why.bs: „Zar nije nad čovjekom prošlo neko vrijeme od vijeka kad nije bio ništa spomena vrijedno?“ – ḥīn iz dahra: neko vrijeme iz dugog vijeka; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za obje riječi.
why.en: “Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?” — a ḥīn out of the dahr: a while out of the long age; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for both words.

why.bs: „… i ništa nas ne uništava osim vijeka …“ – riječi poricatelja; ar-Rāġib: rečeno je da se misli na vrijeme.
why.en: “naught destroyeth us save time [ad-dahr]” — the deniers' words; ar-Rāġib: it was said that time is meant.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, amad i abad su bliski, ali abad je vrijeme bez granice, a amad razdoblje čija je granica nepoznata kad se kaže samo, a može se i odrediti; amad se kaže s obzirom na kraj (ġāya). U Kur'anu 4 puta.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, amad and abad are close, but abad is time without a bound, while amad is a span whose bound is unknown when it is said alone, and it can also be bounded; amad is said with regard to the end (ġāya). In the Quran 4 times.

why.bs: „… poželjet će da između nje i toga bude dugo razdoblje …“ – razdoblje mjereno do kraja; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
why.en: “will long that there might be a mighty space of distance between it and that (evil)” — a span measured to its end; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

why.bs: „… pa im je razdoblje dugo potrajalo i srca su im okorjela …“ – dugo razdoblje do kraja koji im nije bio poznat.
why.en: “but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened” — a long span to an end they did not know.
